item.title: New rules for faiths to stop divorce contracts
item.description: Recognized religious communities in Denmark will face new requirements to maintain recognition. The measures aim to stop what Minister for Church Affairs Morten Dahlin terms “sharia divorces”. The new broad political agreement requires communities to follow Danish marriage laws, including rights to separation, divorce, and remarriage.
